text:
Alex: Pushed a changelog draft for the edge-routing + kv-cache tweaks. URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/edge-routing-cache (WIP). Need quick eyes on known-issues, snippets (py/js), and anchor fixes.

Mina: On it. I'll check anchors and any broken redirects. Noticed a caption mismatch on the Dedicated canary screenshot last week, might be related.

Carlos: Snippets: prefer showing the v1 SDK shape. For streaming show `stream=true` and `cache:{kv_enabled:true}`. I'll draft both py and js.

Jules: Add a "How to opt out" blurb for ops (`cache.kv_enabled=false` in deploy spec) and a rollback one-liner for helm users.

Alex: Good. Also add a small Known issue: 4-bit quant kernels sometimes change token alignment for edge cases (tiny %). Recommend note + link to eval artifacts.

Mina: Found an anchor break: `/docs/dedicated#canary-config` -> now `/docs/dedicated#canary-settings`. I'll push a redirect and update links in the draft.

seo-bot: Reminder: avoid exact benchmark numbers in public changelog. Use qualitative phrasing unless marketing signs off.

Carlos: Draft Python snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.generate(
  model="redwood-edge-1",
  input="Summarize changes",
  stream=True,
  options={"cache": {"kv_enabled": True}, "batch": {"max_tokens": 512}}
)
for chunk in resp.stream():
  print(chunk.text)
```
I'll add JS equivalent.

Jules: I'll add the helm rollback example: `helm upgrade --reuse-values --set cache.kv_enabled=false redwood-inference ./chart` and the kubectl restart line for immediate worker restart.

Mina: After my anchor patch, can docs-bot run a linkcheck? I'll also update screenshot alt text for accessibility.

docs-bot: Linkcheck scheduled for 2026-03-24T20:00:00Z. Snippet linter queued.

Alex: Two final asks: 1) add a short migration checklist for Private customers (`kv_cache.enabled` -> `cache.kv_enabled` and helm override example), 2) a concise "Known issues" bullet with the warmup workaround (curl warmup job) for prefix cache misses when pinning model variants.

Carlos: I'll write the migration checklist and the warmup curl snippet.

Jules: Also include a one-line "contact support" note for customers on Dedicated/Dedicated Private who want help with migration.

seo-bot: After edits, remember to run the canonicalization script for slug changes to keep SEO stable.

Alex: Thanks — aiming to flip to "ready for review" after the linkcheck and snippet linter. If anything blocks, ping me @Alex. :thumbsup:
